chunks: Who hears the revelations of God being recited to him, yet persists in denying with arrogance as though he had never heard them! So warn him of a painful punishment.

key_terms.فَبَشِّرْهُ: so give him good tidings (of punishment)

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who hear God's revelations but reject them with arrogance?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual blindness of the arrogant who, despite hearing the truth, feign ignorance to preserve their ego, a state exemplified by the disbelievers of Mecca and extended to all who reject Imamate. The 'painful punishment' is interpreted not merely as physical torment but as the eternal consequence of severing oneself from divine guidance through willful denial. This condition underscores the critical Shia emphasis on *taqwa* (God-consciousness) versus *istikbar* (arrogance) as the determinant of ultimate success or failure.
